Product Description

Create a serene environment with soothing bergamot, rosemary, and lavender while touches of orange blossom, thyme, and patchouli enhance the calming aromatherapy benefits. Experience a fragrance-filled journey into wellness. From the first lighting, you'll be inspired — the mood-enhancing fragrance infused with pure essential oils and the softly colored frosted glass create a peaceful, spa-like feel. The wood grain lid adds a comforting element of nature, making this candle a beautiful gift for yourself or others.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
The Only Candle I Can Actually Use
I’m pretty intentional about the products I bring into our home, and I’m especially careful with fragrances. Years ago, I completely stopped using candles because I’m extremely sensitive to artificial scents. They can trigger debilitating migraines for me, and I can’t tolerate most fragranced lotions, laundry products, or even many essential oils. Recently, I reached a point where I just couldn’t stand the smell of our home anymore (the joys of having a dog 😂), so I took a chance and searched Amazon for a candle. Lavender has always been one of the only scents I can handle, so I decided to try this one. The Lavender Thyme Serenity + Calm candle is genuinely my favorite candle I’ve ever found. It’s the only one I’ve used that doesn’t leave me with a raging migraine afterward. The scent is gentle but still enough to make your home feel peaceful and fresh. If you’re sensitive to strong fragrances like I am, this one is worth trying. I’m obsessed!!!

    Burn Quality: 4.5/5

    The candle burns evenly and has a nice, steady flame. It lasts longer than I expected, making it great value for the price. However, I did notice that the top layer of wax tends to pool a bit unevenly at first, but it evens out after the second or third burn. No big deal, just something to keep in mind.

    Packaging: 5/5

    The packaging is sleek and elegant. The glass jar has a modern look that fits well with any decor. Plus, the lid is sturdy and helps keep the scent intact when not in use. It’s also the perfect size for placing anywhere—on a coffee table, shelf, or bathroom counter.

    Overall: 4.8/5

    This candle is definitely worth it if you're looking to create a cozy, relaxing environment. It’s great for a gift or for treating yourself to a little self-care. I will definitely be repurchasing once it runs out!

    3 out of 5 stars
    Lovely scent, terrible candle
    Reviewed in the United States on January 18, 2026
    Color: Serenity + CalmSize: 11oz
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I am so disappointed in this candle! I was super happy when I opened it initially, because the scent is absolutely lovely. It smells natural and soothing and I was really looking forward to burning it. After the fact, I was so bummed out. If you look at my pics, it'll look like all the common candle burning mistakes - not burning it long enough, not trimming the wick, being by a draft or breeze - but I can honestly say none of those applied. I used to sell candles and I'm very careful about those things.

    I burned two of these and they were equally awful.

    1 - the wicks are floppy, so they sag as they burn and settle in weird places. Then, next time you light it, two can be super close and one way on the other side. There's no way it can burn evenly after that.

    2- There's so much candle left behind. I'm sure a lot of that has to do with the wicks.

    4- They burn SO FAST. I probably burned them for about 6 hours at a time between two days and that's all I got out of them.

    3 - I didn't realize how much smoke they were giving off until I noticed that they stained my FRESHLY PAINTED walls. I can't even begin to explain how upsetting this was. It took me three coats of paint to get the right color. It didn't wipe off and I don't want to scrub it and mess up the pain even more. Now I'm stuck with this hazy spot where the candle was.

    So, overall impression - I'll never buy these again. It's not at all what I would expect from a Newell brand. Such a disappointment.

About this Item

  • Tranquil notes of exotic jasmine, delicate cashmere woods, white musk, and sandalwood create a soft and peaceful escape
  • The soft colored frosted jar candles allow the light of the flame to shine through when burning
  • Made from a natural soy wax blend and feature self-trimming wicks
  • Our fragrances that are skillfully enhanced with all natural essential oils
  • Designed and poured in the USA, made with ingredients from around the world

Product Description

Create a serene environment with soothing bergamot, rosemary, and lavender while touches of orange blossom, thyme, and patchouli enhance the calming aromatherapy benefits. Experience a fragrance-filled journey into wellness. From the first lighting, you'll be inspired — the mood-enhancing fragrance infused with pure essential oils and the softly colored frosted glass create a peaceful, spa-like feel. The wood grain lid adds a comforting element of nature, making this candle a beautiful gift for yourself or others.
